hazards.description: Metal security shutters on ground-floor units reduce natural surveillance and street-level engagement.
hazards.location_in_image: Ground floor of the central building

hazards.name: Lack of Roadway Markings
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings on a wide road can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: The asphalt roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Poor Lighting Environment
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates significant shadows, potentially reducing visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire street level area under the green bridge structure.

hazards.name: Lack of Controlled Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross an active two-lane road without designated protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway stretch

hazards.name: Low Light Environment
hazards.description: The overhead rail structure creates deep shadows and a dark environment even during daylight, which may significantly reduce visibility at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Overhead and across the roadway surface

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk surface
hazards.description: Cracked and displaced concrete slabs create tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground sidewalk area

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the effective width of the sidewalk to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians and prevent vehicle encroachment.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings and signage to formalize pedestrian movements.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to improve visibility around the support pillars and shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically for the sidewalk area to counteract the deep shadows cast by the elevated rail structure.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk paving
interventions.description: Pave the dirt path on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening/Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the curb around the structural pillars to ensure a consistent and safe walking width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Protective Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards along the curb line to provide a physical barrier between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Designated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Implement clearly marked on-street loading zones to prevent vehicles from mounting the sidewalk to unload.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting levels beneath the elevated rail to increase pedestrian visibility and perceived safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repairing and leveling the concrete slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Installing vegetation to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, improving safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Under-Deck Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install dedicated lighting on the underside of the rail structure to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian-actuated warning beacons to provide a safe crossing point in this commercial corridor.

interventions.title: Under-Structure Supplemental Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting to the underside of the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots and improve security and visibility.

interventions.title: Under-deck Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity, pedestrian-oriented lighting under the rail structure to improve visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Formalize a furniture zone for trash cans and add street trees or bollards to provide a physical buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sections of the sidewalk to prevent trip hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Bollards
interventions.description: Install permanent bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from parking on or obstructing the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Supplemental Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting underneath the elevated structure to improve visibility and personal security in the shadowed environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Management
interventions.description: Relocate trash cans and other movable obstructions to maintain a clear, consistent walking path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or large planters to provide a vertical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace the standard parallel line crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to better alert drivers to the crossing point.

interventions.title: Roadway Rechannelization
interventions.description: Add clear lane markings and potentially a bike lane or parking lane to narrow the perceived travel lanes and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Replace or level cracked and uneven concrete slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Improvements
interventions.description: Encourage the installation of windows or public art/murals on blank wall sections to improve the pedestrian experience.
